annotations.title: Romania company search: name -> CUI/CIF lookup (ONRC)

description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base, no account). FREE: first 3 calls per IP per UTC day (MCP: automatic; HTTP: add &free=1), then paid. Use when you have a Romanian company name and need its CUI (cod fiscal) for the other tools, or to verify a CUI exists. Romanian company lookup / search in the Romania trade register (ONRC, Registrul Comertului) by company name (denumire firmă), CUI/CIF tax ID (RO prefix optional) or registration number (J40/123/2020). Returns up to 30 matches: cui, name, county, locality, ONRC status, activa (active companies first).

q.description: Company name (min 2 chars, diacritics optional), CUI/CIF with or without RO prefix, or trade-register number (e.g. J40/123/2020).

name: romania_company_search
